annotations.text: MASTER — Nour v0.2, ages 15–18. Paper ground, hairline borders, soft shadows, Baloo for headlines only. Same three screens as the row below, same content, same behaviour.
PLAY — Variant A, ages 10–16. Cream ground, 3px ink outline + hard 4px offset shadow, Baloo runs the whole UI, 52px targets. Layers on master; anything absent falls back.
All six frames are iPad landscape 1194×834 — the canonical device. Two pane: her material 58%, tutor 42%. Her material never leaves the screen while she is talking to Nour.

Clickable, not stills. Lesson: tap the hint ladder — nudge → where did I slip → walk me through → show me the answer, which is never withheld. Progress: tap any topic. Welcome: pick a name, or add someone new.

The mastery ramp is #EFEEF6 → #F0A22F → #D9A75A → #8FB98A → #2F9E8F. There is no red and no coral anywhere in either variant: a wrong answer greys out and invites a retry. The dashboard shipped in Phase 8 uses a burnt-sienna ramp and has to change.

Bilingual parity is structural: Arabic and English at equal size and weight, direction on the element, logical properties only, equations always dir=ltr. English-first is a default, not a one-way door.
